units: pixels (image x right, y down) and seconds; no metric scale assumed
summary: Side view of a bowling alley. A dark-blue bowling ball enters at the left edge (frame 4), rolls straight down the lane away from the camera and to the right, strikes a rack of 10 white pins with red neck stripes at frame ~38, keeps rolling through the pin deck and disappears behind the right side wall of the pit after frame 54. Pins scatter and fall from frame 38 on. Camera is static.

camera.motion: static (frame-0 difference is ~0 px in background regions throughout; only ball, its shadow/reflection and pins change)
camera.vanishing_point_note: intersection of 3 fitted lane/floor edge lines and the ball path line, spread about +-70 px in x, +-10 px in y; the ball path (frames 6-37) is a straight line y = -0.08316 x + 678.64 (rms 0.9 px) that passes through the same point, so the ball rolls straight along the lane
camera.horizon_note: only one vanishing point is visible (the lane direction); horizon y ~205 assumes zero camera roll. Principal point assumed at image centre (960,540) - the camera is pitched slightly down. Focal length unknown.

objects.name: ball
objects.description: dark blue marbled bowling ball, the only moving object before frame 38
objects.visible_frames: 4-54 (frame 4: a few-pixel sliver at the left edge, not tracked; 5: cut by left border; 51-54: increasingly hidden behind the right pit side wall)
objects.reference_point: centre of a circle fitted to the ball's outline (= sphere centre projection = object origin)
objects.apparent_size_note: diameter shrinks smoothly as the ball rolls away from the camera (depth increases); roughly diameter is proportional to (cy - 205), i.e. inverse depth. Per-frame free-fit diameter has +-1.5 px noise from motion blur.
objects.path_px: centre from (22,678) at frame 5 to (1725,545) at frame 50, last estimate (1793,542) at frame 54

objects.name: pins
objects.description: 10 white bowling pins with two red neck stripes, standing in a triangle on the pin deck at the right end of the ball's lane; seen from the side so they overlap into a cluster x 1463-1612, y 474-586 at frame 0
objects.moves: static until frame 38, then knocked over and scattered (frames 38-65)
objects.track_file: tracks/pins_region_change.csv (per-frame extent of change in the pin-deck region and of red-stripe pixels; not individual pin tracks)
objects.note: pins overlap heavily; individual pins are not tracked. Pin bases at y~585-586 match the ball bottom (cy+r ~ 587) at frame 38, i.e. the near pins are at about the ball's depth there.

objects.name: ball_lane
objects.description: light grey/white lane surface the ball rolls on, running left-right and receding to the right
objects.extent_px: near-to-far edge (vertical image extent of the bright lane strip): x=100 y 656-766 (111 px), x=400 y 632-736 (105 px), x=700 y 611-705 (95 px); ends at the pin deck/pit x~1780

objects.name: gutters_and_capping
objects.description: dark gutter channel above (far side of) the lane and a carpeted/stone capping rail below (near side); a second capping rail behind the far gutter

objects.name: neighbouring_lane
objects.description: the lane behind (further from camera), with its own pit opening/kickback at x~1110-1290, y 330-500; no pins on it

objects.name: pit_and_kickback
objects.description: dark pit area behind the pins (x 1478-1780, y 357-590) with a grey kickback/side wall at the right (x~1760-1800) that the ball disappears behind; black semicircular openings at x~1440 (y 495-545), x~1300-1340 (y 475-500), x~1070-1105 (y 437-480) and x~1775-1855 (y 557-600)

objects.name: wooden_floor
objects.description: light wooden plank floor in the foreground (approach area, y > ~700), bounded by bright cyan edge strips

objects.name: wall_screens
objects.description: black rectangular screens/panels on the back wall: x 938-1100 y 0-157, x 1272-1557 y 0-142, x ~1880-1920 y 0-118

objects.name: ball_shadow
objects.description: soft grey shadow on the lane below/left of the ball (light from upper right); moves with the ball; not part of the ball mask

events.event: ball enters view at left edge
ball already rolling at entry; no release/bounce seen; straight path along the lane frames 5-37
ball hits the pins (first pin motion, red-stripe pixels change; ball x-step drops from ~31 to ~24 px/frame)
ball begins to pass behind right pit side wall
